'bum/9)
ji ga 4)rngos dzā
ḍi'u brka' ra ༷zhu / ༄ du/mo (14)/ krungago'ibod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus//snyi dza/(1//snyi krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / my-iris ri (

deb bcu bzhi pa'i dkar chag :'bum/ 1tholji (14)0025 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ shā ri'i bu'i le'u/ 78gsum pa/ rab 'byor gyi le'u/ 431bzhi pa/ skyon med pa'i le'u/ 671lnga pa/ kun tu rgyu bzo sbyangs kyi le'u/(stod) 718bsdur mchan/(847) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(884): dkar chag gi zur mchan/ chos tshan (0025)pa 'di la le'u bdun cu don gnyis bzhugs pa las/ le'u'i mtshan re gnyis tsam las ma yig tu mi gsal bas/ de dag gcig gyur dang lta klog bde ba'i ched du 'dir le'u'i mtshan ma yig tu mi gsal ba rnams bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i deb nga gsum pa'i chos tshan (3027)pa gzhir bzung ste ktardornyidhi swākā sdo dang / da dung ma yig tu le'u'i mtshan dang go rim mi 'dra ba sogs kyang 'dir rgya 'grel gnyis dang bstun 1

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/①༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha ta sā sasnaha sri ka prad hā pā grur mi tā /bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam thog ma/ bam po dang po/phya 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig rmyen/bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab ༅kyi ri/ bya rgod 'phungs po rgyal/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / thabs gcig ⑨ste/thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa / khur bor ba/ rang gi don rab tu thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba/yongs su zad pa/ bka' hu )yang dag pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/sems ⑩kyi dbang thams cad la 8pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa sha stag ste/14—3

gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni/ 'di ltar slob pa rgyun tu zhugs pa tshe dang ldan pa kun snatshodaga' bo'o/ /dge slong ma grags 'dzin dang / skye dgu'i cibadag mo chen mo la stsogs sapa lnga brgya tsam dang / dge bsnyen pha dang /dge bsnyen ma zishin tu mang ba kun kyang / chos mthong ba sha stag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshad med grangs myed gyepa thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ stong pa nyid kyis rnam par spyod pa/ mtshan ma myed pa'i spyod yul can/ rtog tsho6pa myed pa'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa rab tu thob pa/ thogs pa myed pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa/ bstan pa zad mi shes pa la so so yang dag par rig pa'i tshul khong du chud pa/ mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par rtse sheb/ mngon par shes pa shin tu ma nyams pa/ mnyan par 'os pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ le lo myed cing brtson 'grus brtsams pa/lus dang srog la myi lta lde ba/ tshul 'chos pa myed pa/ kha gsag myed pa/grags pa dang / khe 9modang bkur sti'i 6sems myed pa/ zang zing myed pa'i chos ston pa/ chos zab mo'i bzod pa dam pa rtogs par khong du chud pa/ myi 'jigs pa chen po thob pa/ yid yongs su zhum pa myed pa/ bdud kyi las thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun chad pa/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang / phyir rgol ba rab tu bcom pa/ pha rol po'i rgol ba thams cad kyis zil gyis 37mi non pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis hu)rtogs par dka' 3)ba/ chos rab tu rtogs pas rnam par dbye zhing bstan pa la mkhas pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa nas smon lam shin tu 14—4

brtsams pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa dang ldan pa/ thog mar smra ba/ khro gnyer myed pa/ snyan cing 'jam pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ pha rol la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs su brjod pa la mkhas pa/ spobs pa myi chod pa/ 'khor mtha' yas pa zil gyis gnon pa'i myi 'jigs pa dang ldan pa/ bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas par bstan pa'i ye shes kyis 'byung ba la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / chu zla dang / phyi lam dang / sgra brnyan shermedang /myig yor dang / nam mkha' dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / sprul pa dang /gzugs brnyan 6lta bur khong du chud pa/ sems yongs su zhum pa myed pa/sems can thams cad kyi/ sems kyi rgyud dang / shes pa phra ba dang / spyod pa dang / mos pa khong du chud par bya ba la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad la sdang ba myed pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bzod pa rlabs po che zhudang ldan pa / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par bya ba'i ye shes la mkhas pa/chos nyid zab mo dang ldan pas gting dpag dka' krub/ rang gi sems la dbang rab tu thob pa/ chos thams cad la dbang shin tu thob pa/ las dang / nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba/brten pa rtogs par bstan pa la mkhas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshul zad myi shes pa la zhugs ⑤pa/ lta ba dang / bag la nyal ba dang /kun nas ldang ba thams cad dang bral ba/ kun tu sbyor ba thams cad spangs pa/las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba la mkhas pa/ bden pa rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i ye shes la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad sgra brnyan 96dang 'dra bar rtag tu rgyun mi chad ⑦par mos pa/ chos kyi tshul bstan pa tshad ldu14—5

myed pa la 'jigs pa myed pa/ bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud par bya ba la mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa rnam par dgod pa'i smon lam gyis 'gro ba yongs su zin pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag tu rgyun myi chad lhapar mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas byung zub thams cad du nye bar 'gro ba zhul mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas dpag tu myed pa la gsol ba gdab par ④mkhas pa/sems can gyi lta ba sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskyed pa'i nyon mongs pa zhi bar bya ba la mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong mngon par bsgrub ⑤pa la rnam par rtse ṣyoba'i ye shes rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa/ yon tan brjod pa bskal pa mtha' yas par mi zad pa dang ldan pa sha stag dang thabs gcig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen 'byung gnas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen byin pa skyidang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ded dpon dam pa dudang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyes bus byin dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyob sbed dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chu bdag lha dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbang pos byin dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang po'i stobs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros dam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems 11—6

dpa' chen po blo gros 'phel ba phyadang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mtha' yas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don yod mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib med blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu dam pas rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus mtha' yas dang /2 byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu sbyor ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi gtong brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba'i snying 3po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros dpe med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug rtsedang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen po skyethob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi stobs rab tu 'joms pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu lag brkyang dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje cher sems dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyan chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 14—7

rnam par bkod pa'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri bo'i zom dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / gzhan yang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas/sku drang por bsrangs te༅/ dgongs pa mngon du bzhag nas/ skyil mo krung ②bcas te bzhugs so/ /der bzhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'du ba dang / khongs su chud pa dang / rjes su 'brang ba dang /'du bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag dugo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen pas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ bya'aphrul gyi spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di la rnam par gzigs so/ /de ltar gzigs nas sku thams cad nas 'od gzer ⑤rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa gnyis las 'od gzer yobye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu ⑨drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs kyi sor mo bcu las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs kyi long bu gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs ④byin pa gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs ⑨pus mo gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs ⑩brla gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /sku sta 7bur gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya 14—8

stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /sku lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu ①byung ngo / /sku rtsib ②logs gnyis las ①kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /thugs ma'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpal gyi be'u las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu khubyung ngo / /phyag gi sor mo bcu las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /phyag lag ngar gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung byung ⑤ngo / /sku phrag pa gnyis las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /mgur nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu byubyung ngo / /tshems mche ba bzhi las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /tshems bzhi bcu las kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /spyan gnyis nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /snyan gnyis nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /shangs kyi sbubs gnyis nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu skyebyung ngo / /steng gi spyi gtsug nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu byung ngo / /zhal gyi sgo nas kyang 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu byung ste/ 'od gzer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu po de dag thams cad kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di duthams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas te/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas 14—9

so / /lho phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /nub phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /byang phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung ①gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung migi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /'og gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang / 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'od gzer rab tu dgye dub mdzad de/ 'od des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /lho phyogs su ④'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /nub phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /11—10

byang phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /'og gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang / 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 37'od kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad de②/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /lho phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /nub phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chem pos khyab par mdzad do/ /byang phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /shar 11—11

lho'i phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /'og gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do / /sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang / 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①zhal gyi sgo nas/ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad ljags kyi dbang pos khyab par mdzad nas/ zhal 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /ljags kyi dbang po de las kyang 'od gzer kha dog sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma 'thon zhute/ 'od gzer de dag thams cad la pad mo mang po rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 'dab cigem stong dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs su 'dug pa/ blta na sdug pa/yid du 'ong ba/ kha dog bzang ba/ dri zhim pa/ 'jam pa/ ka tsa lin ti ④ka ltar reg na bde bar 'gyur ba sha stag kun nas gnas par gyur te/ pad mo de dag la yang byade bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / 'di lta ste/pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston par ⑥mdzad de / de dag shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 14—12

gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi hu)chos ston to/ /de dag lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi ②chos ston to/ /de dag nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi duchos ston to/ /de dag byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi ④chos ston to/ /de dag byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams ⑤kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi ༅chos ston to/ /de dag shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing / de dag tu byon nas/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bsta na pa 'di nyid kyi khuchos ston to/ /de dag lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi duchos ston to/ /de dag nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi 9)chos ston to/ /de dag 'og gi phyogs kyi 11—13

'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi ①chos ston to/ /de dag steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi khuchos ston to/ /sems can gang dugis chos de dag thos par gyur pa de dag ④thams cad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag ⑤ste/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /rdzu 'phrul de mngon par 'du mdzad pas/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to/ /rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go/ /rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg go / /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur/rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig /rab tu shig shig /kun tu shig shig go/ /mtha' mtho na ni dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na ni mtha' dma' ste/ dal bus bags kyis nyams ⑥su bde bar sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba skyed ⑦par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i duskad cig yud tsam ⑨thang cig cil/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang /14—14

log par ltung ba gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad rgyun chad par gyur te/sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang ①skal ba mnyam par skyes par gyur to//rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par skyes par gyur to/ /de nas lha de dag dang / mi de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang sridaga' ba dang / mos pa dang nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong zhing phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das dul phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i byaskad cig yud tsam thang cig phyal/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang / byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems cen de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal ༅te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ⑦dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de 11—15

nas de'i tshe'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig rkyal/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba ②thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis 3sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to④/ /de nas de'i tshe'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig phyal/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang skyergyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de ⑦nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 14—16

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas / zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i che'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig ①la/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang myi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi ②ma rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing duphyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig rtsol/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang / byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten ⑤thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang myi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas myi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang /14—17

nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang / byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang myi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas myi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i ①skad cig yud tsam thang cig la / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang / byol song gi skye gnas thams 14—18

cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten ①thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam ②par skyes so/ /de nas myi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor duzhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can byadamyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang myi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas myi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs ⑤rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 14—19

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i ①skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis ②sdon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas / zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe'i duskad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad dang /byol song gi skye gnas thams cad dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad kyang rgyun chad/ mi khom pa thams cad kyang nub par gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang mi dang lhar skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de nas mi de dag dang / lha de dag dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba de nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ rjes su dran nas kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / nyams bde ba thob par gyur pa de dag rang 14—20

rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa de dag gi drung du dong zhing phyin nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la thal mo sbyor zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can dmus long ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang mig gis gzugs mthong bar gyur to/ /'on pa rnams kyang rna bas sgra thos par gyur to/ /smyon pa rnams kyang dran pa thob par gyur to/ /sems 'khrugs pa rnams kyang 'khrug phyapa myed pa'i sems thob par gyur to/ /gos med pa rnams kyang gos thob par gyur to/ /dbul po rnams kyang nor thob par gyur to/ /bkres pa rnams kyang zas thob par gyur to/ /skom pa rnams kyang btung ba thob par gyur to/ /nad kyis btab pa rnams kyang nad skyed par gyur to/ /lus nyams pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba rnams kyang lus dang dbang po tshang zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /ngal ba rnams kyang ngal sos par gyur to/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dang / 'tsho ba mi dge ba ma spangs pa rnams kyang lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dang / ②'tsho ba mi dge ba spangs par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la dper na/ pha dang ma dang phu nu dang /sring mo dang / mdza' ba kladang / gnyen pa chodang / grogs po dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyis sems mnyam pa nyid du gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan zhing tshangs par spyod pa dang gtsang ba dang / nyes pa'i dri nga ba med de mi dge ba'i rtog ⑤pa thams cad dang bral 14—21

bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad bde ba'i rnam pa 'di lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ dper na dge slong bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba de lta bu'i bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad ①rnam pa 'di lta bu'i shes rab dang ldan par gyur te②/'di ②ltar sbyin pa ni dge ba'o/ /dul ba ni dge ba'o/ /byasdom pa ni dge ba'o//bden ⑤pa ni dge ba'o/ /bag byed pa ni dge ba'o/ /byams pa ni dge ba'o/ /snying rje ni dge ba'o/ /srog chags su gyur pa thams cad la mi 'tshe ba ni dge ba'o zhes bya bar shes par gyur to/ / de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang / kye ma sems can 'di dag 'di ltar sbyin pa ni dge ba'o/ /dul ba ni dge ba'o/ /zhi ba ni dge ba'o / /sdom pa ni dge ba'o/ /bden pa ni dge ba'o/ /bag byed pa ni dge ba'o/ /byams pa ni dge ba'o/ /snying rje ni dge ba'o/ /tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa ni dge ba'o/ /srog chags su gyur pa thams cad la mi 'tshe ba ni dge ba'o zhes bya bar shes pa'i shes rab de lta bu dang ldan par gyur pa ni ngo mtshar to zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /⑥de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs pas/ 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma bsgribs ⑦pa med pa nam mkha'i dbyings yongs su dag pa la 'dug pa'am/ zla ba nya'i duzla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab dang bcas pa/ khor yug dang bcas pa/ lha'i gnas dang bcas pa/ dbang po dang ⑨bcas pa/ dbang byed dang bcas pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi ris dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa 'di 14—22

zil gyis mnan te bzhugs na/ 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ②stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing / lham me lhan ne/ lhang nger bzhugs pa de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang ②/ gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang /dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/'od dang sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne/ lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes shing / lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so//de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan ④te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang /dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs ma tshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du lho nub kyi 14—23

phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te / 'od dang sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi ༅'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs ②kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab sheri nag po gzhan thams cad 5zil gyis non par gnas pa ni mdzes shing / lham me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skar ma'i gzugs thams cad zil gyis non par gnas pa ni/ mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od gzhan thams cad zil gyis non par gnas pa ni mdzes shing lham me/lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ dbang po dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang ⑤/ gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa/ zil gyis non par bzhugs ⑥pa yang / 'od dang / sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das 11—24

kyis / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi stirang bzhin gyi sku ci 'dra ba de bzhin du bstan to/ /②de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i chagatsang ma'i gnas kyi lha'i ris dang / kun snang dang ba dang / tshangs ris dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / 'phrul dga' dang / dga' ldan dang / mtshe ma dang /sum cu rtsa gsum dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa mthong nas/ dga' zhing spro ba dang / yid bde zhing rab tu dga' la nyams bde ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas/ lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi byug spos dang / lha rdzas kyi ud pa ④la dang / padmo dang / ku mu phyed dang / pun da ri ༅ka dang / na li na dang / so'u ⑦gan dhi dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog ke sa ra dudang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang /lha rdzas kyi ba dan mang po thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / byug spos dang / ud pa ⑨la dang / padmo dang / ku mu da dang / pun da ri ⑨ ka dang / na li na dang / so'u yigan dhi dang / me tog ke sa ra tsodang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan dag gis tsobacom ldan 'das 14—25

la gtor to/ /mngon par gtor to/ /rab tu gtor to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ 'dul ba dang / snod du gyur pa'i mi ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / me tog chu las skyes pa dang / thang las skyes pa mang po khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas①la/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par gyur to/ /me tog dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma la stsogs ②pa dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan de dag thams cad kyang de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi brlabs ④kyis/bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog la stsogs ④pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'u/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du ⑥gnas par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de ⑦las kyang / lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / dar gyi lda ldi phyamang po 'phyang bar gyur to/ /mngon par 'phyang khyabar gyur to/ /rab tu 'phyang ⑩bar gyur to/ /me tog dang dar gyi skyelda ldi de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di shin tu mdzes par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba gser gyi kha dog lta bu des kyang /shin tu mdzes shing lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger gyur te'u/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ji lta tsob de bzhin du/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung 14—26

gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snye da kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi tshi'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi ②'od snang ba des khyab cing gsal bar gyur to/ /de la 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta ①bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams ji ltar sems pa de bzhin du/nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi mi rnams kyis④/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta ⑤bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /shar gyi 14—27

lus 'phags po'i mi rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta ①bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas / 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog myi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog myi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /②mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du 14—28

sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas / 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /snang ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /chung snang gi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa ①mthong nas/'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshad med snang ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta 14—29

bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /dge ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mospyi/ /chung dge'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur tephya/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur tezhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te④/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /che ba'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te ge/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /chung che'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur teyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /tshad med che ba'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te⑦/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha 14—30

rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /mi che ba'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /mi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams kyis / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /'og min gyi lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /de bzhin du stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi myi thams cad dang /lha thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta ①bas chog myi shes pa mthong nas/'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi myi thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog 14—31

myi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi myi thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyis/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas chog myi shes pa mthong nas/ 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam mo/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs bzhin du/ 'od rab tu dgye ba ①mdzad de/ yang 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang / rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /'od des stong 11—32

gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /①shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to// 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /dulho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur tol/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/14—33

sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /①nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang duthabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis / byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /dubyang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed 14—34

cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /①byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /②shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to// 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems 14—35

can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to / /nyulho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /②nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig 14—36

rten gyi khams 'di na sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khamaso gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /lha'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ / 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can gang ci snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /zhusteng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag na/ sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag gis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa kun gyi pha 14—37

rol na 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen yod pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas shes hu)bya ba ②bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa du'adi nyid yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas/ snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas ④chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gang na ba der song ⑤ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni/ nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba dubazhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang 14—38

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di ni de'i mthu yin te de 'dra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ①dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang / phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa gzungs dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bsgrub ②pa rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu de ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der song zhushig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba la/ padmo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu ④las byung ba/ gser gyi mdog can 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa ⑤stong bskur ⑤te/ rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la padmo 'di dag gis gtor cig / nga'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang 14—39

dgyes par spyod dam zhes kyang zhus shig /①rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni mgu bar dka' ba yin gyis②/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas de las/ padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab ②ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang /khye'u ④dang / bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed ⑤bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur bstir ⑥bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /14—40

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/bde ba dang dgyes par spyod dam/ zhes 'dri ste padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab ①ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ②ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ padmo de dag bzhes nas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas padmo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ padmo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing /'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di nyid dubartsams te chos ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa de dag gis ④kyang / rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur stir byas sol/ /phu dud du byas so/ /mchod pa ⑤byas so// //14—41

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis pa/de nas lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa kun gyi pha rol na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba yod de/de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas/ snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas ①chog mi shes pa de mthong dunas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshesas pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal gang na ba der dong ⑧ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ④ni byang phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ⑤ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs 14—42

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑨ston te/ 'di ni de'i mthu yin te de 'dra'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan myed pas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ②der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ②ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang / phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa④/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa bsgrub ⑤pa rab tu thob pa/ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa yothams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der song ༅shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan myed pa'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med pa la/padmo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog can 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa ⑤stong bskur 0te/ rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la padmo 'di dag gis tshugator cig / nga'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi 14—43

mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang dgyes par spyod dam zhes kyang zhus shig /①rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni mgu bar dka' ②ba yin gyis / der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan myed pas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal de las/ padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab ④ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyakhyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ lho phyogs kyi zhusangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang bdug ༅spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang gdugs dang / rgyal dumatshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa byed cing byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan med 14wa 44

pasal/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal①/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog ②bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang /dgyes par spyod dam/ zhes 'dri ste/ padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab dum stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis/bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ④ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ padmo de dag bzhes nas/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gis ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas padmo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/padmo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing / 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di nyid yibartsams te chos ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa de dag gis kyang / rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur stir byas so/ /phu dud 14—45

du byas so/ /mchod pa ①byas so/ /de nas nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa kun gyi pha rol na/ 'jig rten gyi khams nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na ②de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro zhes bya ba ③bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' 0sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston ⑤pa mdzad do/ /de rjonas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros shes ④bya ba 'dug 'dug pas/ snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas ②chog mi shes pa de ⑨mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro gang na ba der song ste/ phyin nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro de ⑩la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yi'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phros / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ⑫ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 14wa 46

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te 'di ni de'i mthu yin te de 'dra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/ gzungs dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bsgrub ①pa rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa/ de dag chabalta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa durin chen 'od 'phros bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der song shig④ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phros/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros la/ padmo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog can 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa ⑤stong bskur ༅te/rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra ⑦bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la padmo 'di dag gis gtor cig / nga'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/14—47

zo bdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang dgyes par spyod dam zhes kyang zhus shig /①rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni mgu bar dka' ②ba yin gyis /der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro de las padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab ④ma stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ⑤ji snyed cig thobazhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang spos dang /bdug spos dang phreng ba dang / byug pa dang phye ma dang / na bza' dang rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror rtsibya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa byed cing byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do//phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom 14—48

ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phyonyu/ bcom ldan 'das la snyun myi mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog ②bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang / dgyes par spyod dam zhes 'dri ste/ padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab ⑤ma stong dang ldan pa 'di dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phros / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i slad du bskur ④ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ padmo de dag bzhes zhunas/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gis 'ude bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na ba der gtor to/ /de nas padmo de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad rgyas par khyab par gyur te/ padmo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing /'di ltar ⑦pa rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di nyid ⑧brtsams te chos ston to/ /chos bstan pa de sems can gang gis thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa de dag gis kyang rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la rim gror byas so/ /bkur ster byas so/ /phu dud du byas so/ /mchod pa byas so/ /de nas byang phyogs logs su 'jig 14—49

rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa kun gyi pha rol na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgyal ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ste/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin zhes bya ba 'dug 'dug pas/ snang ba chen po de dang / sa cher g.yos pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku blta bas ①chog mi shes pa de mthong nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par durdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po gang na ba der song ①ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od chen po 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ba dang / dog sa 'di ltar cher g.yos pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di lta bu gda' ba 'di ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo / /de byang chub sems dpa' sems 14—50

dpa' chen po rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ 'di ni de'i mthu yin te de 'dra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kun kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/ gzungs dang so so yang dag par rig pa bsgrub ①pa rab tu thob pa / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu thob pa②/ de dag blta ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang pos bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ltar de'i dus la bab par shes na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der song zhushig /de nas de bzhin gshegs ④pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin la/padmo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog can 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa ⑤stong bskur te'u/ rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la padmo 'di dag gis gtor cig / nga'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo bdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam / bde ba dang dgyes par spyod dam zhes kyang zhus shig /tshurigs kyi bu 14—51

sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bag yod par spyod cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams ①der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni mgu bar dka' ba yin gyis②/ der nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po de las padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab lam stong dang ldan pa de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang 'grogs te / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa byed cing byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ④ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khyazhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas byin gyis/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po/14—52
