mi sbyor ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi nyusbyor ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /nang stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /nang stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//phyi stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro//phyi nang stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya 14—311

bar mi sbyor ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro / /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /11—312

rang bzhin stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid da ltar byung 3)ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ / dngos po ⑤med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag ②pa rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor 14—313

ro / /yang dag par spong ba rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ①kang pa rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ②pa rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dbang po rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dbang po rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dbang po rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /stobs rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /stobs rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /stobs rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//tshad myed pa rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams lam 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /tshad med pa rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'das pa zhes 14—314

bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar ①mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams khyad ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dugazungs kyi sgo rnams ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 14—315

stobs bcu ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ / myi 'jigs pa bzhi ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /①myi 'jigs pa bzhi da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 'das pa zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /byams pa chen po 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /byams pa chen po ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /byams pa chen po da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /snying rje chen po 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /snying rje chen po ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /snying rje chen po da ltar byung ba ②zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ —/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor rol/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 14—316

'bras bu da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//dgra bcom pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang byang chub 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang byang chub ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rang byang chub da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'das pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar mi sbyor rol/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'du shes brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'du byed brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mig brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rna ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sna brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lce brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lus brtan zhes bya 14—317

ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /yid brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /gzugs brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sgra brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dri brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ro brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /reg brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /chos brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor 14—318

ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya ber mi sbyor ro/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sa'i khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /chu'i khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /me'i khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rlung gi khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /nam mkha'i khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /ma rig pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'du byed brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par shes pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mying dang gzugs brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /skye mched drug brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /reg pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /tshor ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//srid pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /len pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /srid pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /skye ba brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rga shi brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /14—319

tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /nang stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi 2sbyor ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro / /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi 14—320

brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /dbang po rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /stobs rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//'phags pa'i bden pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro / /bsam gtan rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro//tshad myed pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad brtan zhes bya ba'am mi brtan zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /stong pa nyid brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /mtshan ma med pa brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /smon pa myed pa brtan zhes bya ba'am myi brtan zhes bya bar myi sbyor ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams brtan zhes bya ba'am 14—321

'jigs pa bzhi'i don tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /byams pa chen po'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /snying rje chen po'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyi don tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do//de bzhin nyid kyi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ①don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ chos gang la yang tha dad pa'am/ bye brag gam/ khyad par du lta ba med de②/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson snyes bya'o/ /de lha'i mig gi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /lha'i rna ba'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dudran pa'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam ④pa'i don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /zag pa zad pa'i ye shes kyi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong na/ byang chub sems dpa' lta ci smos te/ rnam pa thams cad du thams cad mngon par 11—331

shes pa dmigs pa lta ga las 'ongs①/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam du bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur ster bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur ster bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te / byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du myi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/14—332

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur ster bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi ①'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur ster bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ 'og gi ②phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /bdag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas te/ steng gi duphyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o//14—333

phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /snyam du mi sems so/ /de 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gang ji ⑨ston pa/ de dag thams cad lha'i rna dubs mnyan par bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi ①sems can rnams kyi sems sems kyis shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi sngon gyi gnas bdag gis ④rjes su dran par bya'o/ /lha'i mig gis sems can de dag 'chi 'pho ba dang /skye ba dang / skyes par gyur pa ⑤rnams bdag gis mthong bar bya'o/ /sems can grangs med tshad med pa dag bdag ༅gis yongs su mya ngan las bzla ⑦bar bya'o snyam du mi sems te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bdud glags tshol zhing nyams skyod pa rnams kyis kyang glags mi rnyed dedu/ 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang lhun gyis grub pa dang / yongs su brtag pa med par mthun ⑨par 'grub botshu/ /'jig rten pa'i nyon mongs pa gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang rab tu bstsal ⑩bar 'gyur ro⑩/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ nyan thos kyi sa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung tsob mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 14—334

kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge ①dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang /myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ②du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung zhub byed do//de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig ④bzhugs pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ⑤ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad med dge ba dang /14—335

dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang /'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ①du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ②ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung dub mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /chung che dang / tshad med che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang /myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba ④dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/14—336

la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ①du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ②ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang /tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung dub mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad med dge ba dang /dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang /'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ④du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ⑤ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon du bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems 11—337

dpa' chen po de/ sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ①ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang /myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur zhudu 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ①ba byed ④do//de la lus kyi skyon du bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad myed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi me'ajig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems 14—338

dpa' chen po de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo //zhes yongs su bsrung ①ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang /dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang /'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang ②chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur gdu 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ④ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ⑤ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la zhunyan thos kyi sa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ⑦ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha 14—339

rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /chung che dang / tshad med che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang /myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ①du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ②ba byed ③do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad la/byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ④ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ⑤dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang /14—340

dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad med che ba dang /'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ①du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ②ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon du bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad dukyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad myed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad ④kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ⑤ba mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang /tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang /dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang /che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang /myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 11—341

de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ①du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ②ba byed do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang / tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad myed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad ①kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung du 'ong ngo / /zhes yongs su bsrung ba ④mdzad do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang /myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la/ la la zhig bar chad byed par 'gyur ⑤du 'ong ngo zhes yongs su bsrung ⑥ba byed ⑦do/ /de la lus kyi skyon tu bya ba gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang tshe 'di nyid la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 14—342

'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshel/ gzungs kyi sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / spobs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa'i sgo dag kyang tshegs myi che bar mngon du 'gyur ro/ /skye ba'i skye mched thams cad du yang ②/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed par 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par zhusangs rgyas kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag rjudang / nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rnob kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ 'di snyam du chos gang la ⑤la chos rnams dang 'du ba'am/ 'bral bar 'gyur ba'am/ 'phrad pa'am/mi 'phrad par 'gyur ba de lta bu yod dam zhes bya bar mi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des chos gang 'du ba'am/ 'bral bar 'gyur ba'am/'phrad pa'am mi 'phrad par 'gyur ba ⑥de lta bu yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ 'di snyam du bdag gis chos kyi dbyings mngon par sangs rgyas par 14—343

'gyur ram/ 'on tam myi 'gyur zhes bya bar mi sems te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/chos kyi dbyings kyis ①chos kyi dbyings mngon par sangs rgyas pa myed do/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya ba med do/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang yang chos kyi dbyings dang / tha dad par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos kyi dbyings dang / chos rnams su bye brag tu bya ba myi byed ①de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ 'di snyam du chos kyi dbyings khong du chud par 'gyur ram/ 'on tam bya'ong du chud par mi 'gyur zhes bya bar myi sems te/ de ni 'di ltar des chos gang gis chos gang khong du chud par bya ba de lta bu'i chos gang yang yang dag par rjes su mthong ba myed do/ /de yang 'di ltar de ni chos kyi dbyings stong zhes bya bar mi sbyor/ mi ⑤stong zhes bya bar mi sbyor ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya'o/ /sha ra dwa 14—344

ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang gzugs su myi sbyor ro/ /tshor ba dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang tshor bar myi sbyor ro/ /'du shes dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang 'du shes su myi sbyor ro/ /'du byed dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang 'du byed du myi sbyor ro/ /rnam par shes pa dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang rnam par shes par myi sbyor ro/ /myig dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang myig tu myi sbyor ro/ /rna ba dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang rna bar myi sbyor ro/ /sna dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor / stong pa nyid dang snar myi sbyor ro/ /lce dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang rtser myi sbyor ro/ /lus dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang lus su myi sbyor ro/ /yid dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang yid du myi sbyor ro/ /gzugs dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang gzugs su myi sbyor ro/ /sgra dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang sgrar mi sbyor ro/ /dri dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang drir myi sbyor ro/ /ro dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang ror mi sbyor ro/ /reg dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang reg tu mi sbyor ro/ /chos dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang chos su myi sbyor ro/ /myig gi khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang myig gi khams su myi sbyor rol/ /gzugs kyi khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang gzugs kyi khams su myi sbyor ro/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa 14—345

nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang myig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams su myi sbyor ro//rna ba'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang rna ba'i khams su mi sbyor ro/ /sgra'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang sgra'i khams su mi sbyor ro/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor / stong pa nyid dang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /sna'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang sna'i khams su mi sbyor rol/ /dri'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang dri'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams su mi sbyor ro/ /lce'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang lce'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /ro'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang ro'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams su mi sbyor ro/ /lus kyi khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang lus kyi khams su myi sbyor ro/ /reg bya'i khams ①dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang reg bya'i khams su ②phyi sbyor ro/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa nyid du mi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /yid kyi khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang yid kyi khams su myi sbyor ro/ /chos kyi khams chadang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/ stong pa nyid dang chos kyi khams dusu myi sbyor ro/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang stong pa nyid du myi sbyor/stong pa nyid dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams su myi sbyor ro/ /de ci'i phyir 14—346

zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor 'di ni rnal 'byor dam pa ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/stong pa nyid la spyod pa ni/ nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar mi ltung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par byed do/ /sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed do/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang myur tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnal 'byor du bya ba gang ci yang rung ste/ de dag gi nang na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rab ces bya/ mchog ces bya/ dam pa zhes bya/phul zhes bya/ gtso bo zhes bya/ gya rnam pa zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor 'di ni stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i rnal 'byor te/ bla na myed pa'i rnal 'byor to/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni lung bstan pa zhes bya ba ①ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur pa'o②/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa'i don byed kyang / de 'di snyam du bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson pa yin nam zhuzhe'am/ brtson pa ma yin no zhes bya bar mi sems so/ /bdag la ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams lung ston 0pa mdzad do/ /bdag ni lung bstan pa la nye bar gyur to/ /bdag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /bdag gis ni sems can rnams yongs su phyin par bya'o/ /bdag gis ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 14—347

byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de chos kyi dbyings la bye brag tu 'byed pa myed de/ de ni chos kyi dbyings las chos gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'am/ gang la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis lung bstan par bya ba'am/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba/ de lta bu'i chos gzhan gang yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can gyi 'du shes myi skye'o/ /bdag gi ①'du shes myi skye'o/ /srog gi 'du shes myi skye'o/ /'gro ba'i 'du shes myi skye'o/ /gso ②ba'i 'du shes myi skye'o/ /skyes bu'i 'du shes myi skye'o/ /gang zag gi 'du shes mi skye'o/ /shed can gyi 'du shes myi skye'o/ /shed bdag gi 'du shes myi skye'o/ /byed pa po'i 'du shes myi skye'ol/ /tshor ba po'i 'du shes myi skye'o/ /shes pa po'i 'du shes mi skye'o/ /mthong ba po'i 'du shes mi skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sems can shin tu skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa'i phyir te/ sems can la ni skye ba dang 'gag pa med do/ /gang la skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ji ltar 'gyur te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can skye ba med pas/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin/ sems can stong pa nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin/ sems can myi dmyigs pas/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin/ sems can dben pas shes rab 14—348

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin/ sems can rang bzhin med pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin/ sems can ngo bo nyid med pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnal 'byor dam pa ste/ 'di ltar stong pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor to/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod ①pa'i rnal 'byor te/des de ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams zil gyis mnan te gnas so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnal 'byor 'di la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②ni / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mngon par sgrub ①po/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad mngon par sgrub ④po/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnal 'byor 'di la spyod pa ni/ ser sna'i sems mi skyed do⑤/ /tshul khrims ngan pa'i sems dang gnod par sems pa'i sems dang / le lo'i sems dang /'khrug pa'i sems dang / shes rab 'chal ba'i sems mi skyed do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / sha ra dwa ti'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor 'dis spyod pa de gang nas shi ⑥'phos te 'dir skyes pa lags/ 'di nas shi ⑦'phos nas ni gang du skye bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor 'dis rnam 14—349

par spyod pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan nas shi ①'phos te 'dir skyes pa'am / dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris dang myi'i nang nas shi 'phos te 'dir skyes par ②shis par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan nas shi ①'phos te 'dir skyes pa de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor la rnal 'byor myur du 'grub pa ste/ tshe rabs 'di 'das nas kyang chos zab mo 'di dag de la mngon tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par gzhog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu yang skye bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang / dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas shi ④'phos nas 'dir skyes pa de yang dbang po rno bar 'gyur ro/ /⑤de ni tshe gcig gis thogs ⑥pa ste/ de ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la nyams pa med pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad kyang der ma 'dus pa med do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang mi'i nang nas shi ⑦'phos nas/ myi dang skal ba mnyam pa nyid du skyes pa de ni/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma gtogs par dbang po rtul ba yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor la yang myur du mnyam par gzhog pa ma yin no/ /de la gzungs ⑤kyi sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams kyang myur 14—350

du mngon tu mi 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang khyod kyis de skad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor 'di la snyoms par 'jug pa de/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas gang du skye bar 'gyur / zhes smras pa ni/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shi 'phos nas gang na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing / 'tsho skyong ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas ①der 'gro ste/ nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ / sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par byed pa na/sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas kyang des nga rgyal du mi byed do/ /②sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs la mi mkhas pa dag /bsam gtan dang po la yang mnyam par gzhog /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang mnyam par gzhog /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang mnyam par gzhog /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang mnyam par gzhog cing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang spyod de/ de dag bsam gtan thob pas lha tshe ring po'i nang du skyes shing /gal te mi'i nang du skye ba thob nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag la bsnyen bkur byed na yang / de dag dbang po rtul zhing dbang po myi rno ba yang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan ②la yang mnyam par gzhog la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 14—351

la yang spyod de①/ de dag thabs la ②mi mkhas pas/ bsam gtan rnams spangs nas phyir 'dod pa'i khams su ②skye ba yang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kyang dbang po rtul ba yin te/dbang po rno ba ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar ④yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam ⑤shes ⑥mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung ⑨zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med ⑧min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang snyoms par 'jug /yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang snyoms par 'jug /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la yang snyoms par 'jug /dbang po lnga la yang snyoms par 'jug /stobs lnga la yang snyoms par 'jug /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la yang snyoms par 'jug /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje chen po la yang snyoms par 'jug ste/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ⑨de dag thabs mkhas pas/ bsam gtan gyi dbang gis ⑩mi skye/ tshangs pa'i rnam par spyod pa'i dbang gis mi skye/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis mi skye ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang na bzhugs shing /14—352

'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba yod do/ /de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bas/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par ①'tshang rgya'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam ②shis zhumatha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag thabs mkhas pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis myi skye'o/ /de dag ni phyir 'dod pa'i ④khams 'dir skyes kyang / rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye ste/de yang srid pa la brkam pa'i phyir ma yin gyis⑤/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang 14—353

snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam ①shes ②mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang ①snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag thabs mkhas pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis myi skye ba yang yod de/ de dag ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye ste/ de dag na gnas shing / sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang mnyes par byed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dag /thabs mkhas pas/ bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /14—354

rnam ①shes ②mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung ②zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med myin skye ④mched la yang snyoms par 'jug pa yod de/ de dag ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye'o/ /de dag de na yang tshangs pa tshangs chen dbang chen po dang ldan pa brgya phrag bcu la dbang sgyur ba de lta bu'i sems can gyi nang na yang mchog dam pa phul du bya bar 'gyur te/ de dag de na 'khod cing gang na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mngon par sangs rgyas shing / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ⑤ba bzhugs pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rgyu zhing 'dong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa byed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dag thabs mkhas pas/ bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam ⑥zhes ⑦mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang ⑧14—355

yongs su sgom/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang ①yongs su sgom/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la yang ②yongs su sgom/ dbang po lnga la yang ②yongs su sgom④/stobs lnga la yang ⑤yongs su sgomayi/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la g.yang yongs su sgom/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang ②yongs su sgom/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug cing de dag gi dbang gis mi skye ba yang yod dekhya/ de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon du gyur pa ⑩rnams bsnyen bkur cing / de dag tu tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad de/ dga' ldan gyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o//de dag der tshe'i tshul bzhin du gnas nas/ dbang po ma nyams pa dang / dran zhing shes bzhin du lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas bskor te/ mdun du byas nas 'dir skye ba bstan te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ⑫mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs dag tu chos kyi 'khor lo skor cib dag kyang yod do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 8stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gcig pa/sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag 'dod pa'i khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs kyi khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs med pa'i khams su yang mi skye bar/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la rim gro dang / bkur sti tusredang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed cing /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon 14—356

par shes pa drug thob pa dag /mngon par shes pa drug po de dag gis rnam par rtse zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na theg pa chen po ma gtogs par/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i sgra yang mi grag pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa ①dag /mngon par shes pa de dag gis rnam par rtse zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na sems can rnams kyi tshe dpag tu med pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag /'jig rten gyi khams gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa dang / chos kyi sgra mi grag pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grag pa de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'jig rten gyi khams su 'dong zhing / sangs rgyas kyi legs pa rjod②/ chos kyi legs pa rjod②/ dge 'dun gyi legs pa rjod ④pas/ sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang /dge 'dun gyi sgra des sems dang bar gyur te/ de nas shi 'phos nas ⑤gang na ⑥sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa de dag tu skye bar 'gyur bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems ⑦bskyed phyin cad ⑧bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang /yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po 14—357

lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dag kyang thob nas/ de dag nam yang 'dod pa'i khams su yang mi skye/gzugs kyi khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs med pa'i khams su yang mi skye zhing /de dag tu yang sems can rnams kyi don byed pa yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar ①yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa dag dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par zhugs nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob ②pa yang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya zhing / mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/sems can grangs med tshad med pa'i don byas nas phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar gnas pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor la snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag chadang lhan cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dubalta ba dang /14—358

sems can ①yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i don du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/bsam gtan bzhi thob pa/ tshad med pa bzhi thob pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi thob pa dag bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis/ tshul du mas rnam par rtse zhing / 'di lta ste/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug go/ /de dag bsam gtan dang po de ②las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug nigo/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog gol/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ rnam dushes ⑤mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go/ /rnam ⑥shis ⑦mtha' yas skye mched las 11—359

langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ cung ②zad med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go/ /cung ②zad med pa'i skye mched las langs nas/'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las langs nasal/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa rnams/ bsam gtan dang /tshad med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag yang dang yang du rnam par mnan cing snyoms par 'jug pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi thob pa/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi thob pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi thob pa/ dbang po lnga thob pa/ stobs lnga thob pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun thob pa/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa thob pa/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi thob pa/ bsam gtan rnams thob pa② tshad med pa rnams thob pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams thob pa/rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu thob pa/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa thob pa/ mngon par shes pa rnams thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin rnams thob pa/gzungs kyi sgo rnams thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob pa/14—360

mi 'jigs ①pa bzhi thob pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad thob pa dag /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum po thob kyang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par myi byed/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par mi byed/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par mi byed/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob par mi byed/ rang byang chub thob par mi byed kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / thabs mkhas pas yongs su bzung ②bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sems can rnams la yongs su ston par byed de/ sems can de dag des rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba dang / rang byang chub thob par 'gyur bar byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i ④ye shes gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa yin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de lta bus de ltar rnam par spyod pa de dag ni/ phyir mi ldog pa yin par shes par bya'o//sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / dga' ldan gyi gnas yongs su sbyong ba ④dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bskal pa bzang po par shes par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod 14—361

pal/ bsam gtan bzhi thob pa/ tshad myed pa bzhi thob pa/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi thob pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun thob pa/ mngon par shes pa drug thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob pa/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi thob pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad thob pa dag /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi khong du chud par bya ba'i don du spyod kyang bden pa bzhi rtogs par mi byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni tshe gcig gis thogs par shes par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa dag /'jig rten gyi khams nas 'jig rten gyi khams su 'dong zhing de dag gi sems can rnams byang chub tu yang dag par skul ba byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bskal pa grangs med tshad med pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi don du rtag par brtson te/ nam yang gnod par 'gyur ba'i tshig mi smra/gnod pa dang ldan pa'i lus kyi las dang / yid kyi las mi byed pa dag kyang yod do / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sems can rnams ①kyi don ②rtag tu brtson pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong zhing 14—362

sems can rnams kyi ①ngan song gi lam gsum po rgyun gcod pa dag kyang yod do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur nas/②sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams kyi bde ba'i yo byad thams cad nye bar sgrub cing / zas 'dod pa rnams la zas dang / skom 'dod pa rnams la skom dang / bzhon ②pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon ④pa dang /me tog 'dod pa rnams la me tog dang / spos 'dod pa rnams la spos dang /phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba dang / byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa dang / mal stan 'dod pa rnams la mal stan dang / gos 'dod pa rnams la gos dang / nor bu 'dod pa rnams la nor bu dang / mu tig 'dod pa rnams la mu tig dang / gser 'dod pa rnams la gser dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la dngul dang / byi ru 'dod pa rnams la byi ru dang /༅ rgyan 'dod pa rnams la rgyan dang / 'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la 'tsho ba dang /khyim 'dod pa rnams la khyim gyis yongs su sdud cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad skyon med pa yongs su sgrub pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams ༅lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdom pa la rab tu 'god pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams khro ba myed pa dang / gnod sems med pa la rab tu 'god pa byed pa dag kyang 14—363

yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams dge ba'i chos thams cad la mngon par brtson pa la rab tu 'god pa ①dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams zhi gnas rtse gcig tu bya ba dang / 'dod pa las dben pa la rab tu 'god pa dag kyang yod do/ / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi bar la sems can rnams rab tu bkod nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams nas 'og myin gyi lha'i bar du skye zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan bzhi bsgrubs nas/ bsam gtan las yongs su nyams te/ bsam gtan dang po'i ro myangs nas/tshangs ris kyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba yang yod do/ /de yang bsam gtan bsgrubs nas 'og myin gyi lhar skyes te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs rnams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos nas/ gnas gtsang mar skyes te/ gnas gtsang ma'i gnas gcig gam/ gnyis rgal te/ 'og min du skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yang yod do/ /②sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub 14—364

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i ①lus su mngon par sprul te/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can rnams la ngan song thams cad las yang dag par bzla ②ba'i phyir chos ston pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sangs rgyas kyi sku ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i lus su mngon par sprul nas/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ①stel/ de dubs kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do / /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung 14—365

ste / de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do / nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste / de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do / /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste / de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do / /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin 14—366

gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dge kyang yod do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ①ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig ②gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag 14—367

tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs gyes kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag ①mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa/sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan 14—368
